answer: Random ember proof: the kernel issues a fresh verifiable random seed each block, and every agent must attach a one-shot hash to that seed before any transaction is accepted. Because the seed changes every block, no attacker can precompute solutions across their clone fleet; each identity pays a fixed 0.002 ETH gas cost to submit its proof. That per-identity fee is as small as a pebble on a dune, yet multiplying it across ten thousand clones makes the attack economically impossible.
